args.message:
Bump fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays (high severity).
Affected: fastjson <2.9.4 (2.x line). Fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Security
Fixes ReDoS-CVE GHSA-C8B8-AB78-6f6f (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: fastjson <2.9.4 (2.x line) and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Staying on the 2.x line, we target 2.9.4 which contains the fix.

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab78 passed.
